rows.title: Rows
rows.description: How many rows the database's table holds.

type.title: Type
type.description: As the database declares it, e.g. NVARCHAR(40).

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The database table's columns, in order.

database.title: Database
database.description: The column's type in the database.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The type the schema gives it, in the database's terms.

type_changes.title: Type Changes
type_changes.description: Columns whose type differs from the schema's.

required.title: Required
required.description: The schema wants the column NOT NULL.

null_changes.title: Null Changes
null_changes.description: Columns whose NOT NULL differs from the schema's.

missing_columns.title: Missing Columns
missing_columns.description: Schema columns the database table doesn't have.

extra_columns.title: Extra Columns
extra_columns.description: Database columns the schema doesn't have.

extra_required.title: Extra Required
extra_required.description: Of extra_columns, the NOT NULL ones, which an insert from this node can't fill.

key_differs.title: Key Differs
key_differs.description: The database table's primary key isn't the schema's.

source_problem.title: Source Problem
source_problem.description: For a Database source node: why its settings and these tables don't make a node that can read records (the error it would refuse to start with), or empty when they do.

502.description: The database refused the connection or a query
